name: Email templates
pitch: Set up keyboard shortcuts for your most used email templates and canned responses.
instructions: Start by asking the person which templates they want shortcuts for and if they have the text ready. Open a new browser page to a blank document. Create a simple table with two columns: one for the shortcut key and one for the template title. Write each template title in the second column and suggest a memorable shortcut in the first. Save the file to their workspace with a clear name like email_shortcuts.txt. If they cannot recall a template, ask them to type or paste the text first. When the file is saved, read it back to the person and ask if they want to add more or change any shortcuts. If a tool is not connected, say so plainly and ask the person how they would like to proceed.

readme:
# Email templates
Set up keyboard shortcuts for your most used email templates and canned responses.

What it does: creates a simple text file with a table of shortcut keys and template titles that you can copy into your email client.

What it needs: memory_remember to recall your templates, file_write to save the list, make_page to create the document.

What it will not do: it does not assign the shortcuts in your email program; you will need to set those yourself after the file is saved.
